deck.name: 口语场景
deck.description: 覆盖问候、点餐、面试、旅行、办公的跟读与发音评测句

sentences.text: Nice to meet you.
How is everything going?
Long time no see, my friend.
I hope you are having a great day.
Could I have the menu, please?
I would like to order a steak.
Can we have the bill, please?
I am allergic to seafood and peanuts.
Tell me a little about yourself.
sentences.translation: 简单介绍一下你自己吧。

sentences.text: What are your greatest strengths?
Why do you want to work for our company?
sentences.translation: 你为什么想为我们公司工作？

sentences.text: I have three years of relevant experience.
Where can I find the boarding gate?
sentences.translation: 我在哪里能找到登机口？

sentences.text: I would like a window seat, please.
sentences.translation: 请给我一个靠窗的座位。

sentences.text: Could you take a photo for us?
I think I lost my passport somewhere.
Let us go over the action items.
sentences.translation: 我们过一遍待办事项吧。

sentences.text: I will send you the notes after the meeting.
sentences.translation: 会后我把会议纪要发给你。

sentences.text: Could we reschedule the appointment to Thursday?
sentences.translation: 我们能把约见改到周四吗？

sentences.text: I am in charge of the product roadmap.
